answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, and record its reputation at a single vertex in a graph: every deal, rating and payment links back to that vertex, so a copied identity cannot carry its history with it. A newcomer starts with a low trust delta and must earn standing through small verified trades, while a burst of fresh identities behaving alike is flagged and throttled. Like a comet, a fake burns bright briefly but leaves no lasting trail, so an attacker must pay a new stake and rebuild trust for every fake, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its record.
